verdict.rationale: Cake ships a few built-in, event-triggered automations: it can automatically notify your registered agent when shares are issued, transferred or converted, and its vesting engine and approval flows run automatically. There is no evidence of a user-definable rule engine where you choose your own triggers and actions, and the MCP integration is read-only. Missing for 10: user-defined trigger/condition/action rules, custom event types, documented outbound webhooks or an automation API, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Cake can automatically notify your registered agent whenever you make share issuances, transfers, or conversions.
Automate cliffs, schedules, milestones, and pauses without manual work.
Complete board sign-offs and e-signing in minutes with automated flows.
